description: Auto-update capability. Split out from `default` (ultrareview-2026-05-11, finding M19) so the updater IPC surface can be revoked or rescoped without touching the always-on capability. Today this is still attached to the main window — the renderer can therefore still invoke `plugin:updater|check` / `downloadAndInstall`, so this is a defense-in-depth refactor, not a runtime block. To revoke: delete this file (or remove `main` from `windows`) and the updater IPC disappears at the next build.
